_doc: Sampling of the fault campaign (run_faults.py): every block gets min_per_block faults, the rest of the sample is spread over the population's bits in proportion to bits x block_weight (default 1); fault types by probability; on the tile build the core's blocks are sampled on the computing tile only (core_nodes: the M1 workload computes on tile (0,0), the other three cores are idle and their flops would only add masked faults), the tile's other blocks on every node.
_doc_mem: The memory arrays (the SRAM leaves' cells, sampled apart from the flops and in addition to the N flop faults): max(mem_quota, N x mem_frac / the number of memory blocks) faults per memory block, a cell uniformly over the block's bits, the types of mem_types (an SRAM cell's dominant fault is the soft error, a flip).
